The diff only bumps `github/codeql-action/init`, `analyze`, and `upload-sarif` from [v4.38.1](https://github.com/github/codeql-action/releases/tag/v4.38.1) to [v4.38.2](https://github.com/github/codeql-action/releases/tag/v4.38.2) across `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` and `.github/workflows/govulncheck.yml`, matching the group update the title claims. Upstream's only listed change for v4.38.2 is bumping the default CodeQL bundle version; the action's inputs, outputs, and required permissions used at each call site are unaffected.
